name: Honda Ascot FT500 / VT500FT
engine: 498 cc air-cooled single (FT500) or 491 cc liquid-cooled V-twin with shaft drive (VT500FT)
intro: Honda's flat-track styled street bikes. The FT500 is a big single; the 1983 VT500FT is a V-twin with shaft drive.

K: The FT500 uses a chain. The VT500FT uses a shaft, so check the final drive oil and splines instead.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
